column3: Held a midfield spot early - 7th at halfway - eased over to the outer and driven on approaching 3f out - made progress from 2f out - closed to 2nd close home before getting up in the final strides to win

Held a forward spot early - disputing second at halfway before edging in front over 2f out - asked for effort and opened a two-length advantage inside the final furlong - caught close home and unable to find more
Settled midfield - 5th at halfway - driven to advance into 2nd 2f out - pressed for effort inside final furlong - gave up the spot and weakened close home to finish 3rd
Sat close to pace early - third at halfway - pushed for effort with 2f left - lost touch inside final furlong to finish well held in 4th
Missed the break - settled towards back of the field - still there at halfway - asked for effort 3f from home - edged closer late but always held
Hesitant start - held up in the pack - 6th at halfway - lost touch and pressed from 4f out - faded thereafter for a well-held finish
Set the pace early - driven up and lost the front spot 2f out - quickly lost touch and dropped away - finished well adrift
Held up in the pack - 4th at halfway - dropped away 3f out - allowed to coast home well held
Slow to break - held up towards the back and still 8th at halfway - lost touch and pushed along 3f out - allowed to drop away and nearly stopped before the finish
Set the pace from the off - pushed along approaching 2 out - battled on gamely up the run-in despite pressure inside final 110yds - edged clear right on the line

Settled towards the back early - made ground approaching 3 out - urged forward before 2 out to move into fourth - finished strongly to close on the front-runner in the final furlong and denied by a short margin
Held up at back - made gradual progress before three out - pushed along and stayed on up the run-in - moved into third late but no further impression made
Settled midpack early - improved to share second before 3 out - driven approaching last then lost momentum through the closing stages
Settled in the pack - jumped messily in 4th - made progress to share third approaching 3 out - laboured over 2 out under pressure and faded up the run-in
Handy on the outside early - moved into second after four out - lost momentum after an untidy leap two out and beaten into 6th
Tracked front group early - blundered four out - lost touch three out - well held at finish
Settled in a useful position early - pushed along after the fourth from home - blundered three out and dropped away
Held up towards the back - pushed along after 4 out - dropped away 3 out - well beaten in 9th
Sat close to the pace on the rail - dropped away rapidly three out - well held at the finish
Sat close to front group early - urged along and lost touch in a hurry before 3 out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - struggling to find any rhythm - eased and pulled up before 4 out
Held up towards the back - lost touch after a poor leap four out - eased and pulled up soon after
Vied for front early - eased back after 2 furlongs - sat 3rd at halfway - pushed on inside final 3 - moved up to challenge with 2 to go - edged in front late and stayed on strongly to win

Settled in the pack - 9th at halfway - urged forward and moved up on the inner over 2f out - into 2nd inside the last furlong - couldn't quicken again but kept coming - second at the line beaten 1¾ lengths
Sat just behind pace early - midfield around halfway - denied room and asked for effort 3f out - driven approaching final furlong - finished well to nab third late
Handy early - 4th at halfway - driven to dispute lead over 2f out - flat in final furlong - edged out of third close home

Shared front spot early - moved clear from 2f in and held a two length margin by halfway - driven approaching the final two furlongs - overtaken with a furlong left - found nothing more and dropped away close home to finish fifth
Settled in the pack - 8th at the halfway stage - improved into contention with two furlongs left and kept going into the final furlong - lost momentum close home to finish 6th
Sat close to the pace early - 6th at halfway - urged forward approaching 3f out then found extra with 2f left - dropped away in the final furlong to finish 7th
Held up in the pack - urged forward approaching 3f out - shaped up slightly inside final furlong - stayed on at one gear to finish well held in 8th
Held up towards the back - pushed for effort with 2f left - nudged into mid-division approaching the furlong pole - unable to quicken and finished well beaten
Settled in the pack - 7th at halfway - urged forward with 3f left - lost touch approaching 2f out and held to finish 10th
Settled midpack early - slipped to the back before halfway - driven on with 3f left - lost touch approaching final 2f and beaten well home

Settled towards the back of the pack - still 10th at halfway - moved right and made progress on the outside from 3f out - pushed for effort with 2f left - lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish never a threat
Settled in the pack early - 11th at halfway - urged forward approaching 3f out - driven with two to go - lost touch inside the final furlong to finish well beaten
Hesitant start - soon lost touch with main group early on - remained at back throughout - well held in 14th
Slow to break - trailed the field by three lengths inside first two furlongs - unable to land a blow thereafter - well held in 15th
Handy early - disputing second at halfway - dropped away with over 3f left and finished well beaten
Raced eagerly early - tracked the front-runner into contention - edged closer with two furlongs left - driven into command inside the final furlong and held on to win
Settled towards the back early fighting the bridle - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on well inside the final furlong - edged into second right on the line - beaten by half a length

Raced early with plenty of enthusiasm - went to front - driven and challenged for command 2f out before giving way approaching final furlong - continued at a similar effort to the line - edged out for second in the closing strides
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left then edged closer late inside final furlong to finish 4th
Fought for control early - settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - improved to be a threat entering the last furlong before fading quickly - finished fifth
Settled at back early - improved into contention after 4 out - moved left to join issue in third 2 out - driven up to sit behind the front-runner approaching last - edged ahead close home to score

Settled midpack early - improved into contention approaching 3 out - asked for effort before 2 out - hit front before the last - driven out on the run-in but overtaken close home - edged out by a short margin
Sat handy behind the pace - asked for effort 3 out - dropped back 2 out - kept on late for third
Travelled well in touch wide of rivals - urged forward before three out and still holding hopes approaching last - lost momentum on the run to finish 4th
Settled in the pack - driven forward before 2 out - soon well held - finished 5th

Set the pace early - clumsy over 2nd and sloppy again over 5th - scrappy at the following fence - urged on 3 out - stumbled 2 out under pressure - lost front spot before last and faded - eventually finished 6th
Well placed early - jumped awkwardly at the 5th and driven approaching 3 out - soon lost touch to finish well beaten
Held up in the pack - dropped away and pressed for effort 4 out - eased and pulled up before 3 out

Settled on the near flank towards the back of the pack - cruising with plenty in hand approaching 2f out - found space and gained ground when asked a furlong out - driven to the front inside the final 150 yards - drew clear for a comfortable success
Settled midpack on the near rail - asked for effort with 2f left - drifted left under pressure inside final furlong - stayed on to finish second
Held up on the near rail towards the back - urged forward with two furlongs left - driven approaching the final furlong - finished well to snatch 3rd close home

Held up handy on the near flank - drifted right approaching the final 2f - driven up around then - shot to the front briefly inside the last furlong - overtaken with 150 yards left - finished flat and just missed third at the line
Travelled well out wide - up with the pace - hit the front approaching 3f out - asked for effort 2f out - overtaken with a furlong left and had nothing more left to give
Slow to begin - settled towards the back on the inner - asked for effort with two furlongs left - driven approaching the final furlong - kept on close to the rail late to close for sixth
Far rail group - pushed up approaching final furlong - one-paced run-in to finish 7th

Settled towards the back on the near flank early - urged forward passing the two furlong marker - found some improvement under pressure a furlong out - couldn't find more and dropped away close home to finish eighth
Sluggish start - raced up with pace on far rail - driven approaching final 2f - lost whip inside last two furlongs - gave way inside closing furlong - held no threat late
Held up towards the nearside in the main pack - needed urging 2f out - dropped away over 1f out and finished well held in 10th
Held a spot in the middle of the field early - sat closest to the pacesetter - urged forward with two furlongs left - dropped away fast inside the last
Dwelt at the break - held a forward pitch on the far flank - under pressure 2f out - fell away sharply inside the final furlong to finish 12th
Slow to stride - held up towards the back on the far flank - angled left 3f out - drive applied 2f out - effort demanded inside the final furlong but faded - 13th
Held up on the near flank in midfield - pushed for effort with 2f left - lost ground approaching the furlong marker - dropped away without threatening late on
Hesitant start - settled towards the stands rail at the back - urged forward after 2f - driven with 2f left - never a threat and well held
Settled midfield through a middle path early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost momentum inside final furlong under urging - well held at the line
Settled in midfield through the pack - urged forward and drifted off a straight line 2f out - lost momentum under pressure over 1f out - beaten with no impact on the finish
Swerved left at the off - settled midfield through the middle stretch - slipped towards the back and driven from inside the final 3f - well held to finish 18th
Went forward from mid-group early - hit the front travelling keenly - lost command and pushed on approaching 3f out - dropped away fast from 2f out to finish well beaten
Settled with a strong grip early in the pack - asked for effort with 2f remaining - stayed on strongly inside the final furlong - hit the front close home to win
Hampered start - pulled hard settling mid-pack - pushed along 2f out - moved through to hit the front inside final furlong - caught close home to finish second
Tracked the pace close up - pushed into contention approaching 2f out and edged closer to the front-runner inside the final furlong - weakened close home to finish third
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - hit the front before being pressed with three furlongs left - lost the advantage and gave way inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Settled close to the pace - pushed along with 3f left and improved to look a threat entering the last furlong - then dropped away quickly to finish 5th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with 3f left - stayed on at one effort inside final furlong - finished sixth beaten 4¼ lengths
Slow to begin and dropped away early - never involved thereafter - finished well held in 7th
Settled behind the front group early - roused to hit the front 3 out - lost that advantage briefly by a short margin 2 out and driven on - regained command at the last - stayed on strongly to win

Settled at the back early - made steady progress before two out - shared third but lost shape at the last - eased across to the right and pushed out on the run-in - moved into second close home but no more than that
Settled midpack early - improved into contention approaching 4 out - upsides the pacesetter 3 out - nudged into a slender advantage 2 out - overtaken close home and unable to find more despite urging
Held a midfield spot - roused with two furlongs left - stayed on through the final stretch - grabbed fourth close home without threatening the front
Settled midfield - gained ground before 3 out to share third near last - pushed out but weakened over final furlong to finish fifth
Settled in the pack - given a squeeze and hit the second-last untidily - driven but unable to find extra on the run-in - finished 6th
Handy early - urged forward approaching 3 out - lost ground steadily to finish well held
Held up towards the back - urged into effort 3f out - stayed on before fading close home
Set the pace early - driven up before three out then overtaken - dropped away two out to finish ninth beaten well
Settled in the pack early - urged forward approaching 3 out - lost touch with the field 2 out - finished well held in 10th
Settled in the pack - urged forward after 4 out - failed to quicken - finished well beaten in 11th
Held up at the back throughout - never able to make an impression - finished well held in 12th
Tracked the pace in touch early - hit the fourth from home and driven to stay involved - fading before losing rider three out
Settled in the pack early - going nicely two out - pushed through to challenge inside the final furlong - got up close home to score
Handy up front - urged into effort over 2f out and hit the front - drifted left with a furlong left - caught close home and unable to find more inside final 50 yards
Held up at back - angled right and urged forward 2f out - responded to move into contention inside final furlong - closed to grab third close home
Tracked front-runner - urged on with 2f left - closed to dispute lead over 1f out - faded near the finish to come home fourth
Slow to break - settled midfield - eased left and driven on approaching 2f out - unable to close and held for 5th
Set the pace early - driven approaching 2f out then lost the front and dropped away - unable to threaten again finishing well held
Missed the start - dropped well behind the main group after 2f - niggled into the race from halfway - kept at it inside the final furlong but always out of the picture to finish 7th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 3f left - dropped away steadily inside the last two furlongs and finished well held
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with two furlongs to go and finished strongly - got up right at the line

Sprang forward smartly at the off - fought for a strong grip early - settled close to the front group - moved through to go in front 2f out - stayed on into the final furlong - edged in front then caught right at the line
Race run in fits and starts early - stayed close to the front group throughout - found extra in the closing furlong but edged out of second near the line
Pulled hard early - close to the front pack - pressed for effort 2f out - stayed on final furlong - edged out of third close home
Held a middle position - pushed along with two furlongs left - stayed on well late to close finish 5th beaten a length and a quarter
Settled off the pace mid-pack - pushed along with 2f left - closed steadily to the line to finish 6th

Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - sat handy in the pack - pushed along with 2f left as pace pulled clear - stayed on into the final furlong - squeezed for space and shepherded off the pace close home
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 3f left then finding room and improving into the last furlong - blocked for space and pulled back close home to finish 8th
Drifted left at the off - hit the front early - lost command 4f out - pushed along 3f out - kept tap on pacesetter 2f out - overhauled inside final furlong and faded near the finish
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 3f left - dropped back approaching 2f out - responded late to finish 10th

Fumbled and hesitant into stride - settled last of the field - pressed for effort with two furlongs left - found a bit of progress approaching the final furlong but boxed in and pulled up short of full effort late
Raced erratically off the pace at the back - made progress entering final furlong - denied room and pulled back finishing 12th
Race well up with pace early - hit front with 4f left before being asked for effort and giving way 2f out - dropped away in final furlong to finish well held
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with 3f left - couldn't land a blow inside the final furlong - beaten into 14th
Stumbled at the off - never involved - trailed home well beaten in 15th
Slow into stride - never involved with the pack - trailed for the whole trip - finished last of all

Held a midfield position early - made ground into contention by four out - sat handy in fourth into three out - drove up to challenge the front-runner two out - hit the front at the last - kept driving to the line and won comfortably
Set the pace under pressure - kicked clear after 4 out - jumped awkwardly 2 out and came under renewed pressure - lost the front spot at the last - stayed on but outclassed by the winner
Settled in the pack early - made headway 4 out - up to third approaching 3 out - pushed along 2 out - kept on but lacked the speed to get closer
Settled in the pack - error at the second last - plugged on without threatening - well held in 4th
Held up at the back - drifted left over obstacles the whole way - urged forward past four out - kept going without threatening the front runners
Held up in the pack - urged forward 3f out - lost touch with the field through the closing stages to finish sixth
Sat close to front early - urged forward before 3 out - lost touch and dropped away before 2 out - finished seventh well beaten
Settled in midfield - ridden after 4 out but failed to quicken - hampered 3 out and well beaten
Handy with the pace early - shaken up approaching 3 out where bumped - dropped away soon after - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - dropped away with 3 furlongs left - well beaten in 10th
Tracked leading group early - lost touch quickly 4 out - eased and pulled up before the following fence
Settled handy on the stand rail - shaken up to hit the front approaching the final two furlongs - asserted for good inside the last - stayed on comfortably to score

Settled on the near flank sharing early advantage - urged into effort from 3f out - lost command inside final two furlongs - responded to pressure and stayed on through the last furlong - finished 2nd of 9 beaten a length and a quarter

Went forward on the far flank early - hit the front - drifted right approaching 2f out - pushed along inside final 2f and lost command in the last furlong with nothing more to offer - dropped away near the line to finish third
Hesitant start on near flank - settled midfield - began to make progress with 2f left - pushed and angled left a furlong out - stayed on well in the finish - fourth of nine
Held share of front spot early - shaken up and lost command 3f out - drifted left approaching 2f out - driven out with a furlong left - found nothing and dropped away close home - finished 5th
Slow to begin - ran keenly on the far rail - sat behind the pacesetter - urged forward before 2f out - driven approaching the final furlong - stayed on at one gear to finish sixth
Slow to begin - held towards the back on the near rail - pushed up to make progress 2f out but couldn't quicken and dropped away inside final furlong - finished 7th
Settled towards the far flank in midfield - urged on approaching halfway - driven and drifted to the left approaching the final furlong - lost momentum close home - finished eighth
Settled handy near the rail early - asked for effort 3f out - driven approaching final furlong but faded - unable to threaten leading pack - finished well held in 9th
Settled towards the centre in the pack - asked for effort 3f from home - driven with a furlong left but faltered - unable to threaten leading pair - finished well held
Sluggish start - settled towards the back on the near rail - urged forward three out - lost touch approaching final two furlongs - no real threat late - finished well beaten
Settled on the far flank near the back - urged for effort with 3f left - lost momentum inside the last furlong - finished well beaten in 12th
Settled towards the back on the far flank - driven to keep tabs but lost touch from 2f out - well held in 13th
Settled towards the near rail early - urged forward with over 3f left and unable to land a blow - trailed the field to finish last
Went on far flank early - driven from the off and never competitive - last of six rivals - well beaten at the finish
Raced up front eager early - challenged for the front 4f out - pushed along and matched stride for stride 2f out - fought back to go clear inside the final furlong for victory
Bumped at the off - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - closed on the front group soon after - stayed on late to snatch second close home
Drifted right early - settled close to pace - pushed along to reach front around 2f out then locked in fight with eventual winner - couldn't find more and slipped back inside final furlong
Settled with eager energy early - held a spot in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - unable to close from 1f out finishing fourth
Settled at the back - pushed along with 3f left - lost touch with leading pair over 1f later - stayed on late without threatening finished 5th
Held up handy in the pack - shared the lead 4f out - dropped away under pressure inside the final 2f and faded into 6th

Set the pace from the start - urged forward 3f out - came under pressure from a rival soon after - responded well and stayed on under pressure inside the final furlong - edged clear to win on the line
Settled towards the back - boxed in with 2f remaining - moved left and asked for effort inside final furlong - flew home late but narrowly touched off
Settled in the pack - roused with three furlongs left - responded under pressure to close late and claim third close home

Handy early on the wide side - urged forward with three furlongs left and lost momentum - boxed in approaching the final furlong - finished with purpose in the closing stages to be fourth beaten a length and a half
Held up in the pack early - improved into third with 3f left - driven approaching the final furlong - stayed on same gear to finish 5th

Sat behind front pack early - moved up to second three furlongs out and disputed the lead - asked for effort with two left and still in with hopes a furlong out - faded fast inside the final 110 yards - finished sixth
Settled in the pack - asked for effort with over two furlongs left - lost ground final furlong - finished 7th
Settled in the middle of the pack - driven over 2f out and found nothing
Held around midfield early - urged to improve 3f from home - unable to find any headway - well beaten in 9th
Sat close to the front - ridden into contention 3f out - lost touch and finished well beaten in 10th

Slow to break - settled handy through middle of track - moved to front approaching 3f out and asked for effort - stretched away entering final furlong - driven inside last - stayed on well to win in taking fashion
Tracked the pace - driven into contention approaching 2f out and asked for more inside final furlong - stayed on but unable to reel in winner
Held a midfield spot early - asked for effort 3f out then driven with 2f left - improved position inside final two furlongs - kept on well to finish third
settled in the pack - urged forward approaching 2f out - made progress inside that - finished 4th holding steady effort to the line
slow to begin - settled midfield - urged forward with 2f left - driven approaching final furlong - faded near line finishing fifth
Held a forward spot on the wide part of the track - drifted right to link with the pack at halfway - pushed for effort with 2f left - lost momentum inside the final furlong - well held at the finish
Settled midfield early - driven and drifted left approaching final two furlongs - unable to find more and lost ground close home to finish seventh
Held up towards the back - urged forward with three furlongs left - drifted left and driven approaching two out - unable to find more inside the final furlong and made no dent on the leaders
Held handy early - urged into effort by halfway - lost ground under pressure 2f out and never a threat
Hesitant start - settled at the back - urged and drifted left 3f out - unable to find more late finishing well held in 10th
slow to begin - held up towards the back - boxed in approaching 3f out - shifted right and asked for effort with 2f left before fading fast inside final furlong
Set the pace early on a keen rein - urged forward before losing the front spot inside the final 3f - dropped away rapidly with over a furlong left - finished with nothing more in reserve
Drifted right out of the gate - settled at the back and urged forward before 2f - never a factor thereafter - well held in 13th
Held up towards back of pack - driven approaching final 2f and lost touch - finished well held in 14th
Held a forward position early - pushed for effort and lost touch from 3f out - well beaten at the finish
Pulling hard early - settled midpack - pushed along with 2f left - surged to the front approaching the final furlong and stayed on strongly to score
Pulled hard early - settled towards back - pushed along with 2f left - responded to finish well - moved into second inside final 110yds but couldn't get past winner
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - went to front but harried for company - pushed along 2f out then lost advantage inside final furlong - dropped away - found more late to grab third
Pulled hard early - up with the pace - nudged along 2f out - went after the front-runner entering the last - faded in the closing stages to finish 4th
Pulled hard early - settled at the back - pushed along with 2f left but unable to close from 1f out
Fought for control in the early stages - shared the front spot before being asked for effort 2f out - soon dropped away to finish sixth

Settled towards the back early - improved into contention by the 6th - moved up to third 8th - hit the front after 4 out - opened up a big advantage before 2 out - driven out before the last and allowed to coast home unchallenged
Settled just behind the pace - midfield around 5th and hit the 6th - pressed for effort 4 out - kept battling to the line - held second from the last but well beaten
Settled in the pack early - moved onto the front group by the 5th before slipping back after the 9th - urged on with 4 to jump but couldn't find any more - ended up well clear in third at the last
Handy early position - hit front 2nd - lost advantage after 5th - sat behind pace-setter then regained command 7th - lost lead before 4 out and driven up - lost ground 3 out and finished well held
Settled in the pack - jumped without fluency at the 7th and needed riding - struggled from 3 out - finished a distant 5th
Settled in the pack early - dropped away and pressed for effort after the 9th - showed nothing in return - well held in 6th
Sat close to the front early - hit the front after the 5th then relinquished it at the 7th - stayed in touch until fading after the 9th - urged on but faded 3 out - finished well held in 7th
Held up towards the back - pushed along 9th - dropped away 3 out - well held at the finish

Went straight to front - lost that spot briefly but stayed close - regained advantage before 4 out - overtaken after and driven forward - responded with steady effort - still second best to a clear leader when came down at the final fence
held up at the back - crept into 9th - jumped untidily 4 out - driven 3 out and advanced to third 2 out - brought down at the final fence
Settled handy travelling keenly - 5th at halfway - improved into 3rd approaching 3f out - driven with 2f left - sent to the front inside final furlong - drifted right close home - stayed on to win
Sat close to pace early - 3rd at halfway - asked for effort 2f out - moved into runner-up spot inside final furlong and stayed on for second

Settled handy early keeping keen hold - disputing second at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left - hit the front approaching final furlong - knocked sideways inside last - had nothing more left and dropped away close home

Hesitant start - settled midfield and 7th at halfway - urged forward 3f out with progress made - driven with 2f left - stayed on at one gait through the final furlong but couldn't get closer - finished fourth beaten 4 lengths
Held up in the pack - wide throughout - 11th at halfway - pressure applied 3f out - no gap available 2f out - angled right and stayed on strongly inside the final furlong - fifth at the line
Held up towards the back - asked for effort inside final 3f - boxed in over 2f out - shifted right to find room - driven approaching final 150 yards - finished strongly but held for sixth
Set the pace early - travelling keenly - asked for effort approaching 2f out then overtaken with a furlong and a half left - unable to respond and dropped away late finishing seventh
Held up towards back of pack - still 9th at halfway - urged forward with 3f left - driven approaching final furlong - stayed on late without threatening finishing 8th
Held up in the pack - still down the field at halfway - shifted right and asked for effort with 3f left - lost touch from 1f out and finished well beaten
Held up towards the back - given a squeeze to close a gap at halfway but couldn't improve - stayed on at the same speed from 2f out without threatening

Slow into stride - settled towards the back - 10th at halfway - urged forward 3f out - progress but drifted left over 2f out - driven approaching 2f out - couldn't find more and dropped away final furlong
Settled midpack early - 8th at halfway - asked for effort with 3f left - stayed on one gear to the line finishing 12th
Tardy away - dropped to the back and wide - nudged forward 2f out - faded inside the final furlong - well held in 13th
Settled midpack early wide and keen - up to 6th at halfway - urged into progress approaching 3f out - dropped away fast under pressure over 2f out and beaten well
Poor start - immediately adrift at the back - never able to close - well held throughout
Close to pace early - 4th at halfway - driven and drifted right approaching 3f out while catching a knock - dropped away entering the final 2f - finished well beaten in 16th
Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - up with the pace before going in front after 4f - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on final furlong to assert - won going away
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with over two furlongs left then moved into runner-up spot inside the last - unable to reel in the winner and beaten three-quarters of a length
pulling hard early - settled towards the back - pushed along and lost ground 2f out - stayed on well late to snatch third close home

Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - hit the front before being overtaken after 4f - pushed along and staying close to the winner 2f out - continued at a steady effort into the last furlong - dropped a couple of spots close home to finish 4th
Pulled hard early - settled mid-pack - pressed for effort with 2f left but made no impression - lost ground in the closing stages to finish fifth
Pulling hard early - settled towards the back - boxed in and asked for effort 2f out then faded final furlong

Held a midfield position early - made smooth progress from four out - urged forward approaching two out and up to third near the last - much still needed under pressure but kept finding late - closed on the front-runner and got up right at the line
Tracked the pace - hit the front approaching the last and pushed clear - fought back gamely up the run-in but caught right on the line
Set the pace early - drifted left over 8th - pressed for effort 2 out and lost front spot before last - weakened on the run-in to finish third
Settled in the middle order - dropped to the back by the 4th - worked into a share of third after the 12th - pushed along two out and stayed on at one gait to finish fourth
Sat close behind pace early - dropped away from three out - well held at finish
Sat close to the front group early - urged forward 3 out then faded quickly - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - improved into contention around 11th before losing touch and needing urging with a mistake at 4 out - fell back and pulled up after 2 out
Settled in the pack early - dropped away with pushing needed from the 8th and fell further adrift by the 10th - eased out of contention approaching the 13th
